title: 윗입술·아랫입술 대기
caption: 혀끝을 윗입술과 아랫입술에 번갈아 대세요.
motion_prompt: Open the mouth comfortably. Touch the upper lip with the tongue tip, return to center, touch the lower lip, then return to neutral. Do not move the head.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: lips comfortably parted, single tongue resting inside mouth, neutral jaw
single tongue extends upward and the TIP visibly TOUCHES the OUTSIDE upper lip at the center; tongue curves up, upper lip contact clear, jaw and head remain stable
single tongue extends downward and the TIP visibly TOUCHES the OUTSIDE lower lip at the center; tongue curves down, lower lip contact clear, jaw and head remain stable
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_02_touch_lips. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Tile poses: TILE 1: lips comfortably parted, single tongue resting inside mouth, neutral jaw. TILE 2: single tongue extends upward and the TIP visibly TOUCHES the OUTSIDE upper lip at the center; tongue curves up, upper lip contact clear, jaw and head remain stable. TILE 3: single tongue extends downward and the TIP visibly TOUCHES the OUTSIDE lower lip at the center; tongue curves down, lower lip contact clear, jaw and head remain stable. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
